actions.objective: Start /app/alpine.iso in QEMU in the background so that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 reaches a login prompt, and block until the service is ready.
required_behaviors: QEMU must be started in the background
Port 6665 on localhost must accept telnet connections
Connecting with telnet must present a login prompt
known_invalid_patterns: Only checking that QEMU launched without confirming telnet readiness
Only producing non-empty output or a prompt-like string without a real connection
Stopping after a compile/smoke check that does not prove the telnet login prompt is reachable
verification_plan: Inspect available tools and filesystem for the ISO and QEMU invocation details
Start QEMU in the background with serial/console redirected to telnet on localhost:6665
Measure readiness by probing localhost:6665 until the login prompt is observable
Keep the process running and do not finalize until receipt-backed evidence confirms readiness
finalization_evidence_required: Receipt-backed evidence that QEMU was launched with /app/alpine.iso
Receipt-backed evidence that localhost:6665 became reachable
Receipt-backed evidence that telnet to 127.0.0.1:6665 shows a login prompt
notes: Need runtime evidence, not just launch evidence.

next_steps: Locate the ISO and determine the correct QEMU command line
Probe localhost:6665 until login prompt is confirmed
